description: “Erection of a double storey extension to the existing single storey Block B Synagogue, basement excavation and alterations to fenestration and façade”
decision_conditions: <p>Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate a sustainable drainage scheme for the proposed development can be achieved SI12 (Flood Risk Management) and SI 13 (Sustainable Drainage) of the London Plan 2021 and policy LP53 (Water and Flooding) of the Hackney Local Plan 2020.</p>

<p>In the absence of any details relating to air quality, the proposal would conflict with the aims, objectives and requirements of Policy SI 1 of the London Plan and LP58 of the Hackney Local Plan.</p>
<p>In the absence of any details relating to fire safety, the proposal would conflict with the aims, objectives and requirements of Policy D12 of the London Plan.</p>
<p>In the absence of any details relating to urban greening, the proposal would conflict with the aims, objectives and requirements of London Plan Policy G5 and Hackney Local Plan Policy LP48.</p>

<p>In the absence of any details relating to Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG), the proposal would conflict with the aims, objectives and requirements of London Plan Policy G6 and Hackney Local Plan Policy LP47.</p>

<p>The proposed development, in the absence of a satisfactory S106 legal agreement to secure contributions towards&nbsp; employment training, sustainable transport, and to mitigate the impact of the development secure car-free housing and construction and sustainability and climate change impacts is considered necessary to mitigate the impacts of the proposed development. The proposal is therefore considered, contrary to policies T6 (Car Parking), policy T9 (Funding transport infrastructure through planning),&nbsp; policy E11 (Skills and opportunities for all) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP31 (Local Jobs, Skills and Training), policy LP44 (Public Transport and Infrastructure) and policy LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's S106 Planning Contributions SPD (2020), and National Planning Policy Framework.</p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of a lack of sufficient energy efficiency measures and/or financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, would fail to achieve the maximum feasible reductions in carbon dioxide emissions, contrary to Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) Policy LP9, LP54, LP55 &amp; LP57 and London Plan (2021) Policy SI2, SI3, SI4 SI5, SI7&amp; SI2.</p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of its size, siting and design would appear as an unsympathetic and discordant addition to both the host building and wider streetscene, resulting in an adverse impact to character and appearance of the area. As such the proposed development is contrary to policies D1, D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), policy LP1 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of its size, siting and design would appear unduly overbearing and result in unacceptable overshadowing, overbearing and loss of privacy, detrimental to the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to Policy D4 of the London Plan and Policies LP1 and LP2 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</p>

<p>In the absence of suitable information / evidence to fully assess the impact of the proposed development, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions and highway safety, contrary to Policy T3 of the London Plan 2021 Policy T3 and Policy LP43 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</p>

<p>In the absence of adequate disabled parking provision and a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the users of the site would not be able to apply for on street parking permits, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety and sustainable modes of transport, contrary to Policies T1 and T4 of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney Local Plan Policies LP43 and LP45.</p>
